verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const e="lib/ai/vera/execute.ts";if(!fs.existsSync(e))process.exit(79);const E=fs.readFileSync(e,"utf8");const unread=/\n\s*await db\.from\(\x27profiles\x27\)\.update\(/.test(E);const ghost=/SETTABLE_FIELDS\s*=\s*new Set\(\[[^\]]*\x27neighborhood\x27/.test(E)&&!/home_label|FIELD_COLUMN/.test(E);const uncapped=!/DISPLAY_NAME_MAX|BIO_MAX|sanitizeProfileInput|profile-input/.test(E);if(unread||ghost||uncapped){console.error("SCAN-740: set_profile_field still writes a column profiles does not have (neighborhood), ignores the update error, and skips the display name and bio caps, so Vera reports a save that never happened and a member can blank their name.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: FIELD_COLUMN maps neighborhood to home_label, sanitizeProfileFieldValue applies the shared caps and required name, the update error is read, and the confirm action revalidates settings and profile.
